origin.basis: Wolfpack - Tires GmbH is based in Medebach, Germany (legal notice).

manufacturing.basis: Wolfpack does not state where the tire is made.

weight_basis: Wolfpack shop weights (the shop notes weights can deviate about 9%).

availability.note: Sold by Wolfpack's own web shop in euros; other regions not verified.

name: Road Race II (tube type)
positioning: Tube-type Road Race II, marked hookless ready by Wolfpack.
caveats: Wolfpack names it 'Hookless ready', but the site's hookless approvals here apply only to tubeless-ready tires; check the rim maker.

price_observations.conditions: Official shop price on 2026-11-01 (incl. VAT); one tire; shipping extra.

image.shown: Road Race II mounted on a wheel, from Wolfpack's product page; the same photo appears on the TLR page, the construction is not visible and part of the label is out of frame.
image.alt: Wolfpack Road Race tire mounted on a wheel, sidewall logo visible
